description:
"You can end it whenever you want, sir. And the more money, the better."

Among the vile men who targeted me, the only one who was different was Seo Kangwoo.

"I want to sleep with you."

I turned him down, thinking that would be the end of it. But when I was standing at the edge of a cliff, I realized, the only thing I had left to offer was myself.

"I told you, once won’t be enough for me. So how much do you want?"

"You can end it whenever you want, sir. And the more money, the better."

"That’s not a bad deal."

His gaze was cold, but the lips that pressed against hers were burning hot. Eunji wondered if the end of this arrangement might be harder than she dared to hope.

Even so, there was only one choice she could make.
